content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the new Valet accessory, which they described as a "wireless charging stand and personal essentials tray."

Now, Twelve South has expanded the Valet lineup with a smaller option, featuring MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at speeds up to 25W.

The first-generation Valet announced earlier this year measures 7.5 inches, giving you plenty of space to place your phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and other items. However, the new Valet has been significantly reduced in size to 4.25 inches.

Here is how Twelve South describes the ultra-premium design of the Valet:

The Valet is first and foremost a beautiful home accessory, and secondarily a precision wireless charger. It blends warm materials with modern precision craftsmanship to create a more serene and thoughtful silhouette, suitable for placement anywhere in the home—from the entryway table, kitchen, to the nightstand. The soft square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray, while the weighted zinc-alloy base keeps the entire piece stable and tidy.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet has enough power to charge your iPhone. It also features an additional built-in USB-C port for conveniently charging another accessory:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather catchall tray
  • Four configurable placement orientations
  • Interchangeable, removable leather bezel
  • Weighted zinc-alloy base with built-in hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supports up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes 45W power adapter and 1.5-meter USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is now available for order at $129.99, offered in three different color combinations. The price is not cheap, but it is an elegant option that lets you charge your phone while keeping your glasses, wallet, or keys within reach.
